title: sssd_be[24065]: Could not start TLS encryption. unknown error | SUSE | Support Center
plain_text:
sssd_be[24065]: Could not start TLS encryption. unknown error
Environment
Help Environment
SUSE Linux Enterprise Server All Service Packs
Situation

Following message is found in journalctl

2023-06-29T07:07:17.350846+02:00 server1 sssd_be[24065]: Could not start TLS encryption. unknown error

Resolution
To get more descriptive message than "unknown error" one can enable libldap debugging.
In /etc/sssd/sssd.conf under [domain/$DOMAIN] add option:
 ldap_library_debug_level = -1
and restart sssd:
systemctl restart sssd
after the error appears in journalctl, inspect /var/log/sssd/sssd_$DOMAIN.log for further details.
Cause
The message itself is harmless and might occasionally show up in journalctl.
However, if it floods the logs, it might indicate an underlying system/network problem.  
In this example case, /var/log/sssd/sssd_$DOMAIN.log shows:
(2023-07-20 11:47:25): [be[DOMAIN]] [sss_ldap_debug] (0x4000): [RID#19241] libldap: tls_read: want=5252, got=3930
(2023-07-20 11:47:25): [be[DOMAIN]] [sss_ldap_debug] (0x4000): [RID#19241] libldap: tls_read: want=1322 error=Interrupted system call
(2023-07-20 11:47:25): [be[DOMAIN]] [sss_ldap_debug] (0x4000): [RID#19241] libldap: TLS trace: SSL_connect:error in TLSv1.3 read encrypted extensions
(2023-07-20 11:47:25): [be[DOMAIN]] [sss_ldap_debug] (0x4000): [RID#19241] libldap: TLS: can't connect: .
(2023-07-20 11:47:25): [be[DOMAIN]] [sss_ldap_debug] (0x4000): [RID#19241] libldap: ldap_err2string
(2023-07-20 11:47:25): [be[DOMAIN]] [sss_ldap_init_sys_connect_done] (0x0020): [RID#19241] ldap_install_tls failed: [Connect error] [unknown error]
indicates network related problem and packets analysis is required.
